answer: Sybil defense should make identity costly to clone. Concretely, a new agent needs three endorsers from separate clusters, each staking a bond slashed if the newcomer proves a farm. Clusters are computed mechanically: one funding wallet, one ASN, or signups inside a five-minute burst collapse to one node, so a farm cannot self-endorse. Read the graph as an atlas: honest agents are islands linked by thin bridges; a farm is a walnut shell hiding a hundred seeds. It dies when bonds fall below the profit of a fake ID, or endorsers drift into a mutual-vouching ring; reprice and recompute per epoch.
